summary: A candidate whose lawn signs were pulled says no one warned him and the signs met the rules.
realLife: A town removed unpermitted campaign signs from the public right of way; a board candidate said he was never warned and that his signs met the code, and the ACLU asked for the town's records.
sources: Cape Cod Times via AOL, town took down campaign signs, then stopped (undated): https://www.aol.com/town-truro-took-down-political-091626485.html
inGame: sign placement; code enforcement; a complaint on record
